title: Context-dependent effect of high color saturation on trustworthiness
statement:
Higher color saturation can hurt perceived trustworthiness and usability on websites depending on the content domain, so high-saturation palettes should be treated as a contextual choice rather than a universal engagement rule. (ScienceDirect)

Options:
- Muted base: desaturated palette (fits: trust-focused, calm, serious)
- Balanced saturation: moderate saturation (fits: versatile, modern, professional)
- Selective vividness: high-saturation accents only (fits: energetic, attention-seeking, controlled)
- Vivid system: high-saturation full palette (fits: playful, bold, expressive)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general, fintech, health, b2b, ecommerce. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: The negative impact of saturation on website trustworthiness and appeal: A temporal model of aesthetic website perception
source.authors: Alexander Skulmowski; Yannik Augustin; Simon Pradel; Steve Nebel; Sascha Schneider; Günter Daniel Rey
